patterns.pattern: ^The fiery outer layers of ([\w'\-]+) fall away\, turning to dust as they drift to the ground\. Though ([\w'\-]+) seems diminished for an instant\, [\w'\-]+ fires soon rage with fury once more\.$
^The implacable gaze of (\w+) falls upon you, the burning flames that are \w+ eyes flaring brilliantly\.$
^(\w+) reaches out and clasps your face between searing hands, \w+ touch alone searing you to the bone and setting every muscle to spasming\.$
^A brilliant glow begins to emanate from within the raging inferno that is (\w+)\.

^A burning column of fire descends upon (\w+), cloaking \w+ with its brilliance\. The flames merge with those that already cloak \w+, and \w+ becomes little more than an incandescent pillar of light\.
Wreathed in torrid fury, the Elemental Lord (\w+) blazes bright\. (.*)\. (\w+) is little more than a searing column of incandescent light\.
